notes:
v4.6.93 — IBKR Alloc % now shows each bot's LIVE share of the portfolio

📊 The 'Alloc %' column was static (always your original 10%). It now displays each bot's actual current share of the IBKR portfolio and updates automatically as values move:
   share = (this bot's value / total bot value) × your allocated total
So a bot that grows shows a bigger %, and the column always sums to your allocated total — leaving room (under 100%) for the manual reserve and free cash.

✏️ Still fully editable: type a new number to re-allocate a bot (the sum is capped under 100%). Your typed value is used as the new target on Save and only then; the live display never triggers an accidental sell-down. After saving, the field goes back to tracking the live share. Each row also shows the bot's live $ value.

Update via the in-app banner.
